<!--
Headings below are a closed set: use these, in this order, and do not invent
others. Problem, Proposal and Acceptance criteria are required; delete the
two optional ones if they are empty rather than leaving them blank.

Title: "<type>(<optional scope>): <imperative>" - the same vocabulary as
commits, because this title usually becomes the pull request title and then
the squash subject. Types: feat fix docs test ci refactor chore. Scopes:
sync lock backup snapshot config play. Lowercase after the colon, no
trailing period.
-->

restating the title.
